controller_conditions.C: MuJoCo controller condition; C1 and C2 are fixed during identification
controller_conditions.H: hardware controller condition; H1 and H2 are recorded hardware settings

hardware_position.description: physical position-interface data designed to match Sim-Position Data

sim_position.description: hardware-shaped position-interface data generated by the MuJoCo Source Model

sim_torque.description: simulation-only torque-replay data derived from MuJoCo internal effort and state

legacy_schema_notice: The XC330 v1.1 reference remains unmodified. This RS06 adaptation uses its own release ID, 32-episode matrix, fixtures, gains, fields, and hashes.

source_model.role: disclosed MuJoCo model that generates the simulation observations

transfer_rule: The model class, data contract, identification workflow, and evidence rules transfer from simulation to hardware; simulation-fitted candidate values do not become hardware parameters without Hardware-Position evidence.
